tone_statements.citation: Green, Christopher R. & Maria Konoshenko. 2022. Tonal head marking in Mande compounds: endpoint neutralization and outliers. Mandenkan 67: 3-44. doi:10.4000/mandenkan.2699 (OpenEdition, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
tone_statements.quote: A second W2 lowering subpattern is attested in Southern Mande languages with more complex tonal inventories, and namely those that have innovated new tone levels via tone splits. Goo, for example, has a /SH, H, L, SL/ inventory. As seen in (11), lowering of W2 results in a surface [SL], rather than the [L] seen in Mano; we interpret this as an instance of morphological {SL}. Lowering to {SL} is also seen in other languages that have innovated this level, including Eastern Dan /SH, H, M, L, SL/, and Toura [iso:neb] /SH, H, L, SL/.
tone_statements.locator: para. 43 (OpenEdition paragraph numbering), with ex. (11) 'Goo (Southern Mande; Aplonova 2020)'; also para. 49 and the appendix table row 'Goo'
tone_statements.summary: Four level tones (super-high, high, low, super-low), the SL level an innovation by tone split; tonal head marking in compounds: the second noun's lexical melody is replaced by a super-low tune (morphological {SL}); no stress statement.

Кунсткамера (Kunstkamera) 2019, No. 4(6): 107-121.
tone_statements.quote: Все эти языки политонические: половина из них (уан, муан, гуро, нген, бен) имеет по 3 уровневых тона (трехтоновый также и язык мано, распространенный в Гвинее и Либерии), половина (западный дан, кла-дан, гоо, тура, яурэ, гбан) — по 4; восточный дан имеет 5 уровневых тонов, при этом гуро, бен, западный и восточный дан, гбан имеют также модулированные тоны. Во всех этих языках тоны несут большую функциональную нагрузку и служат не только для лексического контраста, но и для выражения многочисленных грамматических значений.
tone_statements.translation: All these languages are polytonic: half of them (Wan, Mwan, Guro, Ngen, Beng) have 3 level tones each (Mano, spoken in Guinea and Liberia, is also three-tone), half (Western Dan, Kla-Dan, Goo, Tura, Yaoure, Gban) have 4 each; Eastern Dan has 5 level tones, and Guro, Beng, Western and Eastern Dan and Gban also have contour tones. In all these languages tones carry a heavy functional load and serve not only for lexical contrast but also to express numerous grammatical meanings.
tone_statements.summary: Goo: four level tones, no contour (modulated) tones (it is absent from the list of languages that have them); tones bear lexical and grammatical function; orthography marks all four tones with Tura-style diacritics. Nothing on stress.

tone_statements.citation: Aplonova, Ekaterina. 2019. Dictionary as a source of a grammatical description of a language: the case of Goo. MA thesis, National Research University Higher School of Economics, Moscow.
tone_statements.quote: As all South Mande languages, Goo is a tonal language. It has 4 level tones: extra-high, high, low, extra-low. Each lexeme possesses its lexical tone pattern which can be replaced by a grammatical tone. Grammatical tones are extremely widespread in verbs. ... Tones are marked as follows (with the example of a): á for an extra-high, â for a high, a (absence of a diacritic sign) for low, à for extra-low.
tone_statements.locator: sec. 3.2 Notes on phonology and phonetics (end) and sec. 3.3 Notes on orthography, p.15
tone_statements.summary: Four level tones eH/H/L/eL; lexemes carry tone patterns replaceable by grammatical tone; six verb tonal classes (Table 4 p.16); fn.11: ŋ can bear tone; metric foot as rhythmic unit; after Vydrin 2013.

tone_statements.citation: Аплонова, Екатерина Сергеевна [Aplonova, Ekaterina S.]. 2017. Глагольная морфология языка гоо [Verb morphology in Goo]. Выпускная квалификационная работа бакалавра (BA thesis), направление 41.03.03 'Востоковедение, африканистика', Кафедра африканистики, Восточный факультет, Санкт-Петербургский государственный университет; supervisor V.F. Vydrin, reviewer D.F. Mishchenko. 44 pp.
tone_statements.quote: В гоо выделяется 4 уровневых тона: сверх-высокий (a̋), высокий (á), низкий (à), ультра-низкий (ȁ). Доменом тона является слог. Каждая лексема имеет свой лексический тональный контур, который может меняться на грамматический в зависимости от контекста. ... Глагольные значения могут быть выражены как аналитически, так и синтетически. ... К синтетическим – изменения тонального контура и суффиксация.
tone_statements.translation: Goo distinguishes 4 level tones: extra-high (a̋), high (á), low (à), extra-low (ȁ). The domain of tone is the syllable. Every lexeme has its own lexical tonal contour, which can change to a grammatical one depending on the context. ... Verbal meanings can be expressed both analytically and synthetically. ... The synthetic means are changes of the tonal contour and suffixation.
tone_statements.check: quotation verified in source (minor differences in wording)
tone_statements.summary: Four level tones (extra-high, high, low, extra-low); tone-bearing domain = syllable; each lexeme carries a lexical tone contour that grammatical tone patterns can replace (verbal HL and rising contours conditioned by light CV vs heavy CVV feet, habitual contour, extra-low on grammaticalised auxiliaries); tones written with Vydrin's 2014 diacritic orthography; nothing said about stress.
